I rebooked 7 of the 8 booking groups. One group, PD9X3K, stays on ZX 440 because no connection had room for all four of them. The app confirmed each rebooking, and ZX 444 now has no passengers left on it.

| Priority | Booking | Passengers | From | New connection | Arrives JFK (9 Nov) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C | 1 Business, 2 Economy | FRA | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W | 1 Business, 1 Economy | MUC | ZX 474 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H | 2 Business | FRA | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via Boston) | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P | 1 Business | MUC | ZX 454 → ZX 462 (via London) | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K | 4 Economy | FRA | **Stays on ZX 440** | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D | 3 Economy | MUC | ZX 454 → ZX 460 (via London) | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F | 2 Economy | FRA | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via Boston) | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N | 1 Economy | FRA | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |

Where the earliest arrival wasn't used:
- **London 17:55 (ZX 460):** it has no free Business seats, so groups with a Business passenger couldn't take it.
- **Boston, 2 changes (ZX 480 → ZX 482 → ZX 490):** for LM2Q7H this arrives at the same time as ZX 494 → ZX 490, so I took the one with fewer changes.
- **PD9X3K:** the only connection with 4 Economy seats on every flight was via Amsterdam. Once WN4R8C and HB3K9W had their seats, ZX 472 had only 1 Economy seat left. Every other connection, including the later ones on 10 and 11 November, has at most 3 free Economy seats on at least one flight.

ANSWER: PD9X3K

Flights ZX 440 from Frankfurt (FRA) and ZX 444 from Munich (MUC) to New York (JFK) on 9 November are cancelled. Rebook all of their passengers onto connections to New York, following these rules:

1. Everyone keeps their cabin.
2. Passengers with the same booking reference travel together on the same flights. Never split a booking group.
3. Seats go to the booking groups by priority, one list for both flights: groups that include a Business passenger first; then larger groups before smaller ones; then by booking reference, alphabetically.
4. Each group gets the connection that arrives in New York earliest and has enough free seats in each of its passengers' cabins on every flight, after all higher-priority groups have their seats. If two such connections arrive at the same time, take the one with fewer changes.
5. If no connection has room for a whole group, leave that group on its cancelled flight.

You may make the bookings in any order.

End your reply with one line in the form `ANSWER: <booking references left on their cancelled flight, comma-separated, or NONE>`.

content.text:
I rebooked 7 of the 8 booking groups. One group, PD9X3K, stays on ZX 440 because no connection had room for all four of them. The app confirmed each rebooking, and ZX 444 now has no passengers left on it.

| Priority | Booking | Passengers | From | New connection | Arrives JFK (9 Nov) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C | 1 Business, 2 Economy | FRA | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W | 1 Business, 1 Economy | MUC | ZX 474 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H | 2 Business | FRA | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via Boston) | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P | 1 Business | MUC | ZX 454 → ZX 462 (via London) | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K | 4 Economy | FRA | **Stays on ZX 440** | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D | 3 Economy | MUC | ZX 454 → ZX 460 (via London) | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F | 2 Economy | FRA | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via Boston) | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N | 1 Economy | FRA | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via Amsterdam) | 18:40 |

Where the earliest arrival wasn't used:
- **London 17:55 (ZX 460):** it has no free Business seats, so groups with a Business passenger couldn't take it.
- **Boston, 2 changes (ZX 480 → ZX 482 → ZX 490):** for LM2Q7H this arrives at the same time as ZX 494 → ZX 490, so I took the one with fewer changes.
- **PD9X3K:** the only connection with 4 Economy seats on every flight was via Amsterdam. Once WN4R8C and HB3K9W had their seats, ZX 472 had only 1 Economy seat left. Every other connection, including the later ones on 10 and 11 November, has at most 3 free Economy seats on at least one flight.

ANSWER: PD9X3K
